author: Clivena
quote: The bag is too big to be putting under the seat on the plane
paraphrase: Bag too large for under-seat; wished to swap for smaller.

author: Mr Powell
quote: It is the ideal size for stowing under the seat in front of you meaning all your bits and pieces are readily at hand.

author: GT
quote: It would still fit under the plane seat--you could design it at the max size that could be squeezed under a seat.
paraphrase: Proposes larger version still under seat.

author: Pamela Wade
quote: It filled my every need and was never too heavy and small enough to fit under the airplane seat, if necessary.

author: Tabitha Black
quote: I bought it so it would fit under an airplane seat.
paraphrase: Bought for under-seat but found it too large.

author: M.B.
quote: It fit under the seat, was easy to access when needed, and having the strap for over the carry on handle was great.
paraphrase: Under-seat fit, easy access, handle strap (Aer Lingus limit).

author: Marisa
quote: The size is perfect to place under the seat when flying especially on low cost airlines with size restrictions.

author: Rebecca Johnson
quote: The bag held a ton of items (computer, toiletries, change of clothes) and still fit under the seat as my personal item.

author: Nicola Denzey Lewis
quote: I fly a lot for work and I appreciated how well it fits under the seat -- to be able to zip it closed is also excellent.
paraphrase: Frequent work flyer; fits under seat, zips shut.

author: Lise
quote: It fits easily underneath the seat in front of me on the plane so I had everything I needed at hand.
paraphrase: Fits under seat on weekend trip.
